title: Care Partner and Family Support in Parkinson's
content: Family members and care partners can play an important role in supporting someone living with Parkinson's disease. Support may include helping with appointments, communication, daily activities, mobility, safety and emotional wellbeing while encouraging the person to remain as independent as reasonably possible. Care needs can change over time and should be adapted to the individual's abilities and preferences. Care partners should also pay attention to their own physical and emotional wellbeing and seek support when caregiving becomes difficult or overwhelming. Significant changes in movement, cognition, swallowing, falls, behavior or ability to perform daily activities should be discussed with an appropriate healthcare professional.
